panels.description: AOS60$ or FabricHostSvc running but no Ax32Serv / FabricHost / Dynamics.AX process observed (DynamicsProcessMissing alert pattern)

targets.expr:
count(
  max by (instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"${service:regex}",name=~"(?i)(AOS60\\$.+|FabricHostSvc)",state="running"} == 1)
  unless on (instance)
  max by (instance) (windows_process_cpu_time_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",process=~"${process:regex}",process=~"(?i)(Ax32Serv|FabricHost|Microsoft\\.Dynamics\\.AX\\..*)"})
) or vector(0)
